method: Full-stream decode plus visual inspection of 24 time-labelled frames in each of the whole-scene and object-detail recordings; initial and lifting frames also viewed at full resolution. Browser playback host unavailable.
observations: Cup, stool and target table are visible in the whole-scene view.
Physical fingers grasp and lift the cup, then navigate and release it onto the destination table.
The detail view shows liquid remaining in the cup and the released cup resting on the table.
No visible spill in reviewed frames, consistent with no above-threshold spill event in the trace.
limitations: The whole view slightly crops the robot base near the final dock; the cup release is visible and the alternate detail view shows final support.
Uniform frame sampling is not a claim of continuous browser playback inspection.
